title: The critical Liouville quantum sphere and geometric limits of FK maps at q=4
main_claim: Thm 1.1: as gamma goes up to 2, the area-marked unit-area subcritical DMS spheres converge to a unique critical sphere law (H, mu_h^crit) with a completed critical metric D_h. Thm 1.2: spherical FK(q=4) planar maps under their equilateral-flag conformal uniformization converge jointly, along the full sequence and with a deterministic scaling a_n, to this sphere (area measure, full embedded distance graph in Hausdorff sense, and all nested interfaces), decorated by an independent nested CLE_4. GHP convergence follows as a corollary.

issues.location: 07-conformal.tex, Lemma conf:germ-determinism and Prop. conf:flag-uniformization (tensor rotation step)
issues.description: The identification of the flag uniformization depends on two claims. (1) Each germ reading, here the normalized differential tensor (Df)^t Df/|det Df|, is a deterministic function of the field germs (h,J). (2) The joint law of the discrete-to-continuum coupling is equivalent to itself under rotations about a typical point. Claim (2) is only asserted ('all readings are intrinsic from the primary cover arrays'). It needs the Section 4 topological homeomorphisms to be built rotation-equivariantly from field and CLE data, and the text does not check this in detail. This is not a demonstrated error, but it is the most load-bearing step that is argued too briefly to verify.
issues.evidence: "The input law after this rotation is equivalent to the original free-embedding law, and the readings transform by exactly these rotated tests."

coverage: Read in full: the introduction and theorem statements (00), all of Section 2 (exact disk encoding, resolvent, singularity, volume LLT, Palm intensity), the first part of Section 1 (circle-average critical chaos, barrier ceiling), Section 9 up to the endpoint reduction (exponent margin, balanced segments, volume spine, band counts, degree bounds), Section 7 from germ determinism through flag uniformization, and the final calibration and subsequential joint proposition in Section 10. Independently checked with python, mpmath and by hand: the FK weight / Euler identity; X^{2n}Z_n ~ 8pi^2/(n^2 log^2 n) from eq (8) via the logarithmic transfer; the full constant chain of the loop intensity 1/(2pi^2) s^{-5} d_s(v)d_s(1-v) (f_k, v_k, N_k/2n, lattice factor 2, binomial mass 2, rerooting 4n/(k+l)); f_p ~ 8 log p/(pi^2 p^2) from the arcsine density; beta -> pi c_*/2; sigma ~ 4 delta/log^2; eq (8) from d eta/dz; the K_1 Laplace identity for pi^2/(8E); V(p) ~ c_*^2/(4f_p), including the atom from the eta/U term; G(2)=0 and G'(2)=0 numerically, along with the two 2log2 integrals; the barrier exponents in the ceiling estimate; the xi >= 1/(2+t) > 1/4 argument; the corollary degree-measure pushforward; and the tanh calibration. Not refereed line by line: Sections 3-6 and 8, and the address-entropy argument in Section 10 (~7k lines). These are very terse, and no concrete failing step was located in the parts sampled.
